title: A nullable nested record inside an array of records - the collision with NO sentinel anywhere
rationale: THE ROW THAT REFUTES THE FRAMING OF [BL-022]. The sentinel-key entry was filed as though the flattener's base-key naming caused the silent loss. It does not: decoding every flat key in the corpus into segment lists finds EIGHT rows where one key is a strict prefix of another, and only FIVE involve a sentinel. This is one of the three that do not. {"orders":[{"id":1,"ship":{"city":"NY"}},{"id":2,"ship":null}]} is ordinary user data - an optional nested object that is present in one element and null in another - and it emits orders_ship, a leaf column created purely by the null, beside orders_ship_city. Renaming the sentinel cannot touch this row. Its AVRO twin already existed as avro/avro-array-of-records-nullable-nested-record-shadowed; the JSON and MAP stacks had no row for it at all, which is why the collision looked like a sentinel problem for six passes.
catchesBugClass: The leaf-versus-branch key collision arising from a nullable nested record rather than from any flattener-internal name. It is the standing evidence that [BL-023] is an independent defect and not a sub-item of the sentinel decision.
cannotCatch: It cannot catch the third non-sentinel producer, the LOWER_CASE dedup suffix - naming/lower-case-collision-suffix-corrupts-structure owns that one and [BL-024] tracks the producer. It cannot distinguish 'ship was null' from 'ship was an object whose city was null' either: both flatten to a null in the orders_ship_city column, which is a separate ambiguity that no reconstruct-side repair can resolve from the flat form alone.

predicted.detail: PREDICTED, to be replaced by the recorder. Flatten is expected to emit {orders_id, orders_ship_city, orders_ship}. Before 2.1.0 reconstruct returned {"orders":[{"id":1,"ship":null},{"id":2,"ship":null}]} - the nested record {"city":"NY"} deleted from the document with no exception and no log. Since [BL-023] the collision is refused with KeyCollisionException. That is deterministic and loud, and it still does not reproduce the source.

expected.mapDoc: THROWN: KeyCollisionException: leaf/branch key collision: the key 'orders_ship' is also an intermediate path of [orders_ship_city], so the reconstructed node at 'orders_ship' would have to be a scalar and an object at once. If any of [orders_ship_city] was meant as a lit
